alt: Wide shot of the United Nations General Assembly hall in New York packed with world leaders and delegates, with Trump visible at the podium and on the large video screens above
story: At the UN General Assembly on September 22, 2026, President Trump announced the US would rename 'artificial intelligence' to 'super intelligence' in all government documents — ignoring the three renaming choices (Superior, Extreme, or Supreme Intelligence) he had asked his Truth Social followers to vote on just days earlier.
why_funny: He crowdsourced three name options, picked none of them, and announced the fourth to the entire world at the UN.
